programs.title: The Fourth Wall
programs.desc: The year 1982, war-torn Lebanon.Theater director Georges (Laurent Lafitte), in order to keep his promise to his terminally ill friend, goes to Beirut to implement a risky project.He intends to put "Antigone" on the front line to guarantee a moment of peace for the parties to the conflict.The show will feature actors involved in fighting, belonging to various political and religious factions.Marwan (Simon Abkarian) becomes a guide in an unknown city, who explains the background of the dispute to the foreigner and becomes a link with the locals.Soon Georges faces the brutal realities of war.The plans are also complicated by the feelings he has for one of the actresses, Imane (Manal Issa).

programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programs.title: Peacemaker 2
programs.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programs.title: The Alto Knights
programs.desc: The year is 1957. Former friends from their teenage years, Frank Costello (Robert De Niro) and Vito Genovese (Robert De Niro), are now the most famous New York bosses, fighting for control of the city streets.When one day the first of them becomes the target of a failed assassination attempt by his rival, he decides it's time to step aside.He informs Vita about this, but he - a man paranoid about losing power - does not believe him.Soon he orders another attack.His victim is Albert Anastazja (Michael Rispoli), appointed by Frank as his successor.This event makes Costell realize that if he does not stop his rival, he will again attempt to kill both him and his loved ones.The conflict between two former friends and now rivals escalates, leading to a dramatic climax.A film inspired by real events.

programs.title: Murder In Glitterball City
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the crime that took place in 2010 in Louisville, Kentucky.In the basement of the home of Jeffrey Mundt and his boyfriend, Joseph Banis, police found the mutilated body of James Carroll.
